# ext_frame_buffer

SDR SDRAM-backed frame buffer with queued pixel writes and serialized four-address reads.

ext_frame_buffer is design-local IP of [`vision_system`](../../README.md).

## Directory structure

| Path | Contents |
|------|----------|
| `src/` | RTL |
| `tb/` | self-checking testbench, tests in `tb/tests/` |
| `scripts/` | file lists (`build.f`) and flow scripts |
| `docs/` | diagrams, prompt, register table, web page |
